settings.title: Why Choose a Lab-Grown Diamond Engagement Ring?
settings.content:
Lab-grown diamond engagement rings offer the perfect blend of beauty, sustainability, and value. At MiaDonna, we believe your ring should be as extraordinary as the love it represents. That’s why each of our lab grown diamond rings is crafted with precision, using ethically sourced materials.

Every MiaDonna lab-grown diamond engagement ring comes with a lifetime guarantee, 60-day return policy, and the promise of giving back—one tree planted for every purchase and a portion of profits donated to our non-profit, The Greener Diamond. When you choose a MiaDonna lab grown diamond ring, you're choosing craftsmanship, conscience, and a commitment to a better diamond industry.

settings.title: From Classic to Contemporary Designs
settings.content:
Whether you’re drawn to sleek modern styles or timeless vintage elegance, MiaDonna offers lab grown diamond rings to match every aesthetic. Our collection incorporates contemporary designs that reflect today’s latest trends to classic silhouettes that remain eternally stylish.

Each ring is thoughtfully crafted to celebrate your individuality and designed to reflect your unique love story. With MiaDonna, finding a lab grown diamond engagement ring that perfectly aligns with your personal style is effortless and inspiring.

settings.title: Why Choose an Ethical Engagement Ring?
settings.content:
MiaDonna is redefining what it means to shop responsibly with our ethically-sourced lab grown diamond engagement rings. Each ring is handcrafted using lab grown diamonds, lab-created gemstones, and recycled precious metals—ensuring your jewelry reflects both beauty and integrity.

Our lab grown diamond rings not only offer stunning style but also contribute to a more sustainable future. When you choose a MiaDonna engagement ring, you’re making a conscious choice—for the planet, for communities, and for love.

settings.title: Discover Stunning Lab Diamond Jewelry
settings.content:
Lab grown diamonds and gemstones are every bit as real as their earth-mined equivalents. The only difference is their origin (and price). Lab-created or cultured diamonds and gemstones are optically, physically, and chemically identical to their earth-mined counterparts. Our diamond engagement rings are made without the humanitarian and environmental conflicts that are so prevalent in the mining industry. Additionally, they are up to 40% more affordable.

From modern rings with unconventional and innovative designs to vintage and antique style rings that conjure visions of times gone by, we have breathtaking lab-grown diamond rings to suit all tastes. Perhaps you would prefer a stackable engagement ring to complement your stackable wedding band or, maybe you appreciate the radiant sparkle of a three-stone ring to signify you and your partner’s past, present and future together. No matter your personal style, we have something special for you.

settings.title: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.content:
What are conflict-free engagement rings?
Conflict-free engagement rings refer to diamonds and gemstones created using ethical, ecologically friendly, and socially conscious practices. Since all MiaDonna's diamonds are lab-grown or recycled, they are 100% conflict-free.

Can I design my own engagement ring with MiaDonna?
At MiaDonna, we can help you bring your unique vision to life with a custom-designed engagement ring. By choosing from a range of settings, metals, and lab-grown diamonds or gemstones, you can create a ring that perfectly captures your and your partner's unique style and bond. Our team is here to guide you through every step of the design process, ensuring that your custom ring is a true reflection of your love.

What metals are available for MiaDonna engagement rings?
For women's engagement rings, MiaDonna offers a range of premium metals, such as platinum, 14K and 18K white, yellow, and rose gold, as well as recycled and environmentally friendly metals.

How do I determine the correct ring size?
To find the correct ring size, use a ring sizing chart or go to a nearby jeweler for an exact measurement. You can download MiaDonna's ring size guide to guarantee a precise fit at home.

What are the most popular engagement ring settings?
Classic solitaires, halo settings, romantic three-stone settings, and vintage designs are the most popular engagement ring settings at MiaDonna. The beauty of the center stone is accentuated by the unique styles offered by each setting.

Can engagement rings be resized?
Yes, MiaDonna offers engagement ring resizing. However, the design and metal selected may determine how much resizing is necessary.

Does MiaDonna have a store where I can try engagement rings?
Yes, MiaDonna has a store in Portland, Oregon. You can visit the store to browse the collection in person and find the perfect engagement ring.

settings.title: Lab-Grown Diamond Engagement Ring Buying Tips
settings.content:
• Recognize the Four Cs: To make an informed decision, familiarize yourself with a diamond's four primary characteristics: cut, color, clarity, and carat weight.
  • Establish a Budget: Establish a budget to help you focus and ensure you select a ring within your means.
  • Select the Correct Metal: To match the diamond and your partner's style, consider the longevity and aesthetic appeal of various metals, such as rose gold, white gold, yellow gold, or platinum.
  • Recognize Your Spouse's Style: To choose a ring that complements their taste, find out what kind of jewelry your partner prefers—classic, vintage, or modern. If your partner loves one-of-a-kind items, go for a customized ring!
  • Lifestyle Consideration: Based on your partner's everyday activities, choose a ring that will be both pleasant to wear and durable.
  • Ethical Sourcing: Choose diamonds and materials from ethical sources to guarantee that your jewelry is exquisite and ethically manufactured.
  • Ring Size: Before making a purchase, be sure you know your partner's ring size to prevent the need for resizing.
  • Certification Is Important: To ensure a diamond's quality and authenticity, always select one certified by a recognized grading organization such as GIA or AGS or B Corporation Certified.
  • Examine the Future: Consider whether the ring will complement additional bands or jewelry that your significant other might like to wear.
  • Take Your Time: Examine your options carefully and seek expert advice if necessary. Don't make a snap decision.

settings.title: Your Purchase Makes a Difference
settings.content:
MiaDonna is a company on a mission. Knowing that most earth-mined diamond engagement rings play a significant role in the devastation of impoverished communities, we decided to change the industry. In 2005, MiaDonna became the world’s first retailer exclusively selling lab-grown diamonds and gemstones. Since then, we have continued to actively push for change, donating at least 10% of our annual profits to mining-impacted communities in need.

If you would like to inquire further about any of our lab-created diamond rings or want to modify a design, please contact us for a free consultation with one of our friendly, non-commissioned jewelry experts. Our lab grown diamond engagement rings include free shipping in the USA, free, no-risk, 30-day returns, and free resizing (one full size up or down within the first 90 days of purchase).

Celebrate this once-in-a-lifetime occasion with an heirloom-quality ring that will always remind you of the commitment you share and the love you have found.
